[RTIM.3.1.4] Selecting the mock mode puts the harness clock in place of the
live one for every reader of the clock source: the pump, the timer agenda, TTL
expiry, the clock tick, fact timestamps, and every expression that reads the
time ([RTIM.1.2]). The switch, its origin and when it is admitted are
[NLFC.5.4]'s.
